local p = {}

local function trim(s)
	if not s then return nil end
	return mw.text.trim(s)
end

local function splitCSV(str)
	if not str or str == "" then
		return {}
	end
	local out = {}
	for item in mw.text.gsplit(str, ";") do
		table.insert(out, trim(item))
	end
	return out
end

function p.main(frame)
	local args = frame:getParent().args
	local skills = {}

	for i = 1, 4 do
		skills[i] = splitCSV(args["skill" .. i])
	end

	local html = mw.html.create
	local root = html("div")

	local collapsible = root:tag("div")
		:addClass("mw-collapsible mw-collapsed")
		:css({
			width = "80%",
		})
		:attr({
			["data-expandtext"] = "Show table",
			["data-collapsetext"] = "Hide table"
		})

	collapsible:tag("h3")
		:css({
			["font-size"] = "14px",
			["font-weight"] = "bold"
		})
		:wikitext("Skill upgrades")

	local content = collapsible:tag("div")
		:addClass("mw-collapsible-content")

	local tableEl = content:tag("table")
		:addClass("mrfz-wtable")
		:css({
			width = "100%",
			["table-layout"] = "fixed",
			["text-align"] = "center",
			["font-size"] = "12px",
			border = "3px solid #3c3c3c",
			["margin-bottom"] = "0"
		})
		:attr({
			border = "1",
			cellpadding = "5"
		})

	local header = tableEl:tag("tr")
	header:css("border", "3px solid #3c3c3c")
	header:tag("th"):css("width", "50px")
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local name = skills[i][1]
		local th = header:tag("th")
		if name then
			th:tag("span")
				:attr("title", name)
				:css("cursor", "help")
				:wikitext(name)
		else
			th:wikitext("&ndash;")
		end
	end

	for row = 1, 11 do
		local tr = tableEl:tag("tr")
		tr:tag("th")
			:wikitext(string.format(
				"[[File:Rank %d.png|35x35px|center|link=]]",
				row + 1
			))
			:css("width", "50px")

		for col = 1, 4 do
			local val = skills[col][row + 1]
			local td = tr:tag("td")
			if val then
				td:wikitext(val)
			else
				td:wikitext("&ndash;")
			end
		end
	end

	return tostring(root)
end

return p
